deltas.finding: The row is appended to written only after both target writes and the post-write hash check. Any exception while writing STATUS or checking the entry hash leaves the current row mutated but absent from the rollback list.
deltas.requiredRepair: Register a rollback record before the first target mutation, or wrap each row in its own rollback guard that restores the current row as well as prior rows.

deltas.finding: closureReceipts defaults to an empty list, so an authorized manifest can install without any closure binding. When receipts exist, only path/hash are checked; the receipt schema, hardPass, cohort identity, and listed artifact hashes are not validated.
deltas.requiredRepair: Require a nonempty closureReceipts list and validate each bound closure schema, hardPass=true, cohort membership, and agreement between closure output hashes and manifest rows.

deltas.finding: Entry IDs are lexically constrained, but resolved fresh-build source and terms target paths are never checked with contained(). A pre-existing symlink at fresh-build/entries/<id> or terms/<id> can redirect reads or writes outside the intended roots.
deltas.requiredRepair: Reject symlinks and require every resolved source file under FRESH and every resolved target/temporary path under TERMS before reading or writing.

deltas.finding: A ledger write failure triggers term rollback, but a partially pre-existing ledger or ledger .tmp artifact is not included in rollback accounting. os.replace makes the final ledger atomic, yet stale temporary state is not cleaned.
deltas.requiredRepair: Include ledger/tmp cleanup in the transaction and refuse or explicitly validate pre-existing ledger collisions.

passes.finding: The supplied manifest itself is constrained beneath maintenance and matched to the caller-provided SHA-256 before parsing.
Each entry, worksheet, and WORK hash is checked, and the worksheet is compiled in memory and byte-compared with entry.v2.json before mutation.
A different pre-existing term entry and a non-done STATUS are refused during preflight.
The implementation writes only terms entries/status plus maintenance backups/ledger; it invokes neither merge nor deployment, and the ledger explicitly records both as false.

residualRisk: Do not execute until the three hard defects are repaired and independently retested with injected failures and symlink fixtures.
